header.title: Curse tablets from Barbaricum (Epigraphic Database Heidelberg): AI translation (Claude)
header.author: Greek curse tablets
header.source: Translated by Claude (claude-opus-5-5, Anthropic) from the library's urn:defix:edh:barbaricum:grc, from the Epigraphic Database Heidelberg (CC BY-SA 4.0), one English line for each line of the original. Only some passages are translated so far: those that the Atlas of Ancient Myth, Magic in the Ancient Texts and the demons-and-angels study cite.
header.statement: An AI-generated translation. No specialist has reviewed it.
header.availability: CC BY-SA 4.0, as its source requires: credit the Epigraphic Database Heidelberg and this AI translation, and share adaptations under the same licence.

notes.36000.1: The tablet holds only names and magical words, with no verb; capitals are kept where the edition leaves the letters undivided, and AT (line 1) may run on into line 2. Abraim may be Abraham. Lines 13-16 list Macedonian month names in irregular spellings, given in their usual forms; 'Arimeos' (Ἀριμέως) is unidentified, and ĒIPERBERBERET looks like a garbled Hyperberetaeus.
